title: dir-analysis-tool configuration
description: Configuration for dir-analysis-tool (dat). Place it in .dir-analyzer.json or dir-analyzer.config.json.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style patterns to skip, relative to the analyzed directory.

maxDepth.description: Directory levels to descend; 0 scans only the top-level files. Default: unlimited.

followSymlinks.description: Follow symbolic links (cycles are detected). Default: false.

countHardlinks.description: Count every hard link separately instead of counting shared data once. Default: false.

minSize.description: Only include files at least this large. Bytes, or a size such as "512k", "25MiB", or "1GB".

maxSize.description: Only include files at most this large. Bytes, or a size such as "512k", "25MiB", or "1GB".

newerThan.description: Only include files modified after this point. An age such as "30d", "6mo", or "1y", or a date (YYYY-MM-DD).

olderThan.description: Only include files modified before this point. An age such as "30d", "6mo", or "1y", or a date (YYYY-MM-DD).

top.description: Length of the largest files and folders lists; 0 hides them. Default: 10.

largeFiles.description: Report files at least this large; true uses 100 MiB. Bytes, or a size such as "512k", "25MiB", or "1GB".

minDuplicateSize.description: Ignore files smaller than this when looking for duplicates. Bytes, or a size such as "512k", "25MiB", or "1GB".

empty.description: Report empty files and empty folders.

stale.description: Report files not modified since this point; true uses one year. An age such as "30d", "6mo", or "1y", or a date (YYYY-MM-DD).

treeDepth.description: Levels shown by the tree. Default: 3.

units.description: Size units: "iec" (KiB, MiB; powers of 1024) or "si" (kB, MB; powers of 1000).

budgets.description: Rules that must hold, or the run exits with code 2. Metrics: size, disk, files, dirs, largest, large, duplicates, wasted, empty, stale, errors.
